mapper.select: SELECT /* Common.retrieveMessageList */ SYSTEM_MESSAGE_ID , LANGUAGE_CODE , MESSAGE_DESC , MESSAGE_DETAIL_CONTENT , MESSAGE_TYPE_CODE FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_MESSAGE_M

SELECT /* Common.retrieveMenuList */ M.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_M_NAME, M.SYSTEM_CODE, M.PROGRAM_MODULE_CODE AS MODULE_CODE, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.PROGRAM_TYPE_CODE, M.LINK_URL_ADDR, M.URL_ADDR, M.DISPLAY_FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_SERVICE_N LPS WHERE LPS.PROGRAM_ID = M.PROGRAM_ID AND LPS.CONTROL_FLAG = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS "SERVICE_COUNT" FROM LGCOM_MENU_R_V M WHERE PROGRAM_ID IS NOT NULL
AND M.MENU_ID = #{menuId}
SELECT /* Common.retrieveDebugList */ PROGRAM_ID , APPLICATION_USER_ID FROM LGCOM_DEBUG_SETUP_M WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y'
SELECT /* Common.retrieveServiceList */ PROGRAM_ID , SYSTEM_SERVICE_ID , PROGRAM_ID || '/' || SYSTEM_SERVICE_ID as "PROG_SERV_ID" FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_SERVICE_N WHERE CONTROL_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT /* Common.retrieveProfileList */ lp.profile_id ,lp.profile_name ,lpts.profile_apply_tg_class_code ,lpts.apply_target_value ,lpts.profile_option_value FROM lgcom_profile_m lp ,lgcom_profile_target_setup_n lpts WHERE 1 = 1 AND lp.profile_id = lpts.profile_id AND lp.use_flag = 'Y' AND lpts.use_flag = 'Y' ORDER by lpts.profile_apply_tg_class_code
mapper.insert: INSERT /* Common.createAccessLog */ INTO LGCOM_SYSTEM_ACCESS_LOGGING_N ( EXECUTION_YYYYMM , LOGIN_SERIAL_NO , APPLICATION_USER_ID , MENU_ID , ACCESS_DATE , LOGIN_IP_ADDR , CREATED_BY , CREATION_DATE , LAST_UPDATED_BY , LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') , LGCOM_SYSTEM_ACC_LOGGING_N_SEQ.NEXTVAL , #{applicationUserId} , #{menuId} , #{accessDate} , #{loginIpAddr} , #{createdBy} , SYSDATE , #{lastUpdatedBy} , SYSDATE )

INSERT /* Common.createServiceTimeLog */ INTO LGCOM_SYSTEM_SERVICE_LOGGING_N ( EXECUTION_YYYYMM , LOG_SEQ_NO , APPLICATION_USER_ID , MENU_ID , PROGRAM_ID , SYSTEM_SERVICE_DESC , ACTUAL_START_TIMESTAMP , ACTUAL_END_TIMESTAMP , CREATED_BY , CREATION_DATE , LAST_UPDATED_BY , LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') , LGCOM_SYSTEM_SVC_LOGGING_N_SEQ.NEXTVAL , NVL( #{applicationUserId}, -1 ) , NVL(#{menuId}, 'Main') , NVL( #{programId}, 'XXXX' ) , NVL( #{systemServiceDesc}, 'XXXX' ) , #{actualStartTimestamp} , #{actualEndTimestamp} , #{createdBy} , SYSDATE , #{lastUpdatedBy} , SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT /* Common.retrieveCommonCodeListForCache */ code_type_code , common_code AS code , common_code_name AS name , parent_common_code AS p_code , language_code AS language_code FROM ( SELECT lct.code_type_code , lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name , lccm.language_code , lcc.parent_common_code , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lct.code_type_code, lcc.sort_order_no, lcc.common_code) AS row_num FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) ORDER BY row_num, common_code

SELECT /* Common.retrieveCommonCodeForCache */ code_type_code , common_code AS code , common_code_name AS name , parent_common_code AS p_code , language_code AS language_code FROM ( SELECT lct.code_type_code , lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name , lccm.language_code , lcc.parent_common_code , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lct.code_type_code, lcc.sort_order_no, lcc.common_code) AS row_num FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lcc.code_type_code = #{codeTypeCode} AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) ORDER BY row_num, common_code

SELECT /* Common.retrieveAttachFileInfo */ laf.file_id ,laf.file_group_id ,laf.system_code ,laf.module_code ,laf.file_name ,laf.file_desc ,laf.file_size ,laf.file_location_info ,laf.expiration_date ,laf.archive_date ,laf.archive_flag FROM lgcom_attach_file_info laf WHERE laf.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT /* Common.retrieveAttachFileInfoByGroup */ laf.file_id ,laf.file_group_id ,laf.system_code ,laf.module_code ,laf.file_name ,laf.file_desc ,laf.file_size ,laf.file_location_info ,laf.expiration_date ,laf.archive_date ,laf.archive_flag FROM lgcom_attach_file_info laf WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId}
SELECT /* Common.retrieveExportInfo */ * FROM xxlge_export_info WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq_no
SELECT /* Common.retrieveNewAttachFileReqNumber */ lgcom_attach_file_group_seq.nextval AS FILE_GROUP_ID FROM DUAL
SELECT /* Common.retrieveNewAttachFileId */ lgcom_attach_file_seq.nextval AS FILE_ID FROM DUAL
SELECT /* Common.retrieveImportDataFromLgcomTemp */ COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LGCOM_IMPORT_INFO_T WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO /* Common.insertExcelUploadLgcomTempData */ LGCOM_IMPORT_N SELECT * FROM LGCOM_IMPORT_INFO_T
mapper.select: SELECT /* Common.retrieveUserOwnSystemList */ a.system_code AS code , b.system_name AS name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT system_code FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N urn , LGCOM_ROLE_M rm WHERE urn.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND urn.role_code = rm.role_code AND NVL(urn.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) < SYSDATE + 1 AND NVL(urn.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND NVL(rm.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) < SYSDATE + 1 AND NVL(rm.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) a , ( SELECT lcc.common_code AS system_code , lccm.common_code_name AS system_name , lcc.sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) b WHERE a.system_code = b.system_code(+) ORDER BY b.sort_order_no

SELECT /* Common.retrieveUserOrganizationList */ code, name, short_code FROM ( (SELECT um.default_org_id AS code , hou.name AS name , hou.short_code FROM LGCOM_USER_M um , LGCOM_COMPANY_V hou WHERE um.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND um.default_org_id = hou.organization_id(+) ) UNION ( SELECT ou.organization_id AS code , ou.name AS name , MAX(ou.short_code) AS short_code FROM LGCOM_COMPANY_V ou WHERE (ou.date_to IS NULL OR ou.date_to >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N lrb , LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N lur , LGCOM_ROLE_M lr WHERE lrb.role_code = lur.role_code AND lur.role_code = lr.role_code AND (lur.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lur.apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (lur.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lur.apply_end_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AND (lr.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lr.apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (lr.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lr.apply_end_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AND lur.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND lrb.organization_type_code = 'C' AND lrb.company_id = ou.organization_id) GROUP BY ou.organization_id, ou.name ) ) ORDER BY code

SELECT /* Common.retrieveDynamicAccessGroupList */ code, name FROM ( SELECT lcc.common_code AS CODE ,lcc.common_code_desc AS NAME FROM lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_DQ_ACCESS_GROUP' AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' ) WHERE 1 = 1
AND code IN ('ALL',#{accessGroup})
ORDER BY code
{ call /* Common.setApplicationProgram */ dbms_application_info.set_module( #{module, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{action, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) }
